answer: By the marble of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A relic of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jetty of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt.
